# GTS File

## Summary
The FileDef specialization for Glimmer TypeScript card/component source. An instance is an uploaded realm
file with card semantics: the binary lives at the file URL, the card
carries metadata and renders with source-aware formats.

## Example
```ts
import { GtsFileDef } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/gts-file-def';

@field attachment = linksTo(GtsFileDef);
```
Instances are created by upload (`createFileDef` wires the type from the
MIME type). Live examples need uploaded fixtures — same fixture pass as the
File renderer specs.
